intelligence.essence: Smart Match is Naya's way of connecting you with the people who really matter to you — the people most like you, who share what you love, where you're from, and what you believe. It works automatically, in the background, from the moment you join.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you walk into a giant playground, and a kind friend already knows which kids love the same games you do — and walks you straight over to them. That's Smart Match: it finds your people for you.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine moving to a new town, and on your very first day, a neighbor walks over and introduces you to all the people who love the same things you do — your cooking, your garden, your stories. That's Smart Match: you belong from the moment you arrive.
